sections.content: Negative commands tell someone NOT to do something. Unlike English (which just adds 'don't'), Spanish uses a DIFFERENT verb form for negative informal commands: 'no' + present subjunctive ending with switched vowels.

items.spanish: No comas dulces antes del almuerzo.
No abras la puerta a desconocidos.
items.english: Don't open the door to strangers.

sections.content: Notice the switched vowels: -AR verbs take -es in the negative (no hables), while -ER/-IR verbs take -as (no comas, no abras).
